# Butler v0.0.12

## Change Log

- Fixed packaged Butler App update status so App update checks and apply dry-runs
  use the Electron-provided App version instead of falling back to the bundled
  Agent runtime version.
- Propagated `BUTLER_APP_VERSION` through bundled supervisor, Electron-rendered
  launchd/systemd services, foreground daemon App-managed service specs, and the
  Linux package-owned background service launcher.
- Re-rendered native service definitions on start so upgraded Apps do not keep a
  stale App version in existing launchd/systemd service environment files.
- Added release packaging regression coverage for divergent App and bundled
  Agent versions, including Linux package-owned service launcher contents.
